message.content: The song "A Hard Day's Night" was released in July 1964, while the 1964 European Nations' Cup took place in June 1964.
message.reasoning_content:
Song released July 10, 1964. Euro 1964 final June 21, 1964. But "released in same month"? Album July, single June? "A Hard Day's Night" single released July 1964? Actually the single was released 10 July 1964 in UK. Event June 1964. Answer no.

Wait Euro 1964 was June 10–21? Final June 21. No.
